text:
Jules: Quick poll, Rina's birthday next week. Two low-effort options that travel well: tiny pinata kits (mini, candy sachets, easy to mail) or desk-care package (small succulent + care card). Thoughts?
Carlos: Pinata kits sound fun for the office video, but succulents are less messy for remote folks.
Priya: Vote: desk-care package. easier for shipping and lasts longer.
Mina: Pinata KITS :party_popper: remote folks can pop confetti GIF instead.
people-ops-bot: :ballot_box: Poll started 1 current tally: pinata_kits 1, desk_package 1
Jules: Logistics: pinata kits would need someone to assemble ~8 kits and store them. desk package needs succulent wrapping that survives 7+ day transit.
Carlos: I can assemble and store 6 kits if we go pinata route. will need tape, mini candies, string for hanging.
Priya: If we do desk packages, can we include a tiny printed care card + a link to a 30-second prerecorded video? remote-friendly.
Rina: I like the plant. also allergic to peanuts so please no peanut candy if anyone chooses pinata.
Mina: Good call on allergies. Also suggest adding a tiny curated playlist link on the card. I can make one.
people-ops-bot: :memo: Reminder created: "Confirm gift type + allergy notes" scheduled for 1950030000.
Jules: Budget: $140. 7 remotes. Succulent + card ~ $18 each incl shipping. Pinata kit ~ $12 + assembly time. Both fit budget but plants are slightly higher.
Carlos: If pinata wins, remote folks get a small candy sachet and a confetti GIF in #general at 11:30. If plant wins, I'll pick up from UrbanGreens and ship.
Priya: Vote count now 2 desk, 2 pinata. Tie-breaker time! Anyone else?
Mina: I'll break tie for plants. also will design playlist and virtual confetti GIF for the call.
Jules: Plant wins 3-2. Mina can you post the playlist link and people-ops-bot can schedule the virtual GIF at 11:30?
Mina: Will post playlist link and short voice note.
people-ops-bot: :bell: Scheduled: virtual confetti GIF in #general at 11:30 on 1950090000.
Carlos: I'll add "no-peanuts" to shipping notes. Also who can DM me addresses?
Priya: I'll send the address spreadsheet. Please don't paste addresses on the thread.
Jules: Optional micro-fund for nicer wrapping: $3 suggested. Venmo @redwood-bday.
Rina: Thanks everyone! Appreciate the care :smile_heart:
people-ops-bot: :tada: Thread closed, plan=desk-care-package (succulent + card + playlist), budget_est=$140, remotes=7, owners=[Carlos,Mina].
